relations.subject: Colin Mackenzie
relations.evidence: Under Raffles's aegis, a large number of ancient monuments in Java were systematically catalogued for the first time. The first detailed English-language account of Prambanan was prepared by Colin Mackenzie

relations.subject: H. C. Cornelius
relations.evidence: Under Raffles's aegis, a large number of ancient monuments in Java were systematically catalogued for the first time... while the Buddhist temple of Borobudur was surveyed and cleared of vegetation by H. C. Cornelius.
